title: Company View — Guide
subtitle: A read-only training walkthrough with sample data and an explanation of every section
demoBanner: Training mode — all data on this page is sample data shown for demonstration only. This guide is the read-only «Company View», where everything is locked.

labels.realControlNote: The real control for this section is shown below, in read-only mode.

quickStart.title: What does this page do?
quickStart.intro: The «Company View» page is a fully read-only view of a company's information:
steps: First a company is selected; until then nothing is shown.
After selecting, the same sections as «Company Information» appear: name history, registration & legal, emails, phones, addresses and stakeholders.
But everything is locked: there are no add/edit/delete buttons and no «Update» button.
To change data, go to the «Company Information» (edit) page; this page is for viewing only.
The side cardex shows a summary of the company profile status.

selection.title: Select company
selection.intro: The card at the top used to pick the company to view. Until one is selected, no section is shown.
tips: This is only for selecting a company; no editing happens on the selection itself.

nameHistory.title: Name history
nameHistory.intro: The company's names over time with translations (Persian/Latin), start/end dates and the «current» flag. View-only here.
tips: A row with no end date is the company's current name.
Add/edit/delete buttons are not shown in this view.

registrationLegal.title: Registration & legal
registrationLegal.intro: Registration data: dates and number, place of registration (country/province/city), national ID and economic code. All fields are disabled.
tips: In the real view these fields are read-only and there is no «Update Company» button.

emails.title: Emails
emails.intro: The company's emails with label, address, and the «primary»/«verified» flags — view only.
tips: «Primary» shows a yellow star and «verified» a green check.

phones.title: Phones
phones.intro: The company's phone numbers with label, number (E.164) and «primary»/«verified» flags — view only.
tips: Numbers are shown in international format (+ and country code).

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.intro: The company's addresses with label, location (country/province/city), street, postal code and «primary» flag — view only.
tips: A 10-digit postal code is shown as 5-5.

stakeholders.title: Stakeholders
stakeholders.intro: People/companies with an ownership relationship, with stakeholder type, ownership %, share count and dates — view only.
tips: Use the arrow at the start of a row to see each stakeholder's history.
In this training sample the related-party name shows as «unknown» because it is not connected to real data.

sidebar.title: Cardex (profile overview)
sidebar.intro: The side panel showing a summary of the company profile (completion rate, verified info, last update).
tips: This panel is purely informational and is shown in the view too.

items.q: How is this different from «Company Information»?
items.a: The content is the same, but «Company View» is fully read-only: no add/edit/delete and no update button. To change data, use the «Company Information» page.

items.q: Why can't I see any section?
items.a: Because you haven't selected a company yet. Select one from the card at the top first.
This page is for viewing; all controls are intentionally disabled. Editing happens on the «Company Information» page.
